description: This file defines the Store class within the Opencart Admin Model Setting namespace, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve store information in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It interacts with the database, cache, and other system components to manage store configurations and related data.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: A model class for managing store data such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving store information within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Inserts a new store record into the database, assigns layout routes, SEO URLs, clears relevant cache, and returns the new store ID.

methods.name: editStore
methods.description: Updates existing store data in the database, clears cache, and removes associated layout and SEO URL data across various related tables.

methods.name: deleteStore
methods.description: Deletes the store record and all related layout, URL, SEO, and configuration data from the system.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific store identified by store_id.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Fetches a list of all stores, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Initializes and returns a store instance with autoloaders, registry, configuration, language, URL, request, response, database, cache, session, template, and system setup for a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalStores
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLanguage
methods.description: Counts stores configured with a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCurrency
methods.description: Counts stores configured with a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCountryId
methods.description: Counts stores located in a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLanguage
methods.description: Counts stores configured with a particular language.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCurrency
methods.description: Counts stores configured with a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByZoneId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific zone ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific customer group ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByInformationId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with specific information IDs such as account and checkout.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific order status ID.
